content: **使用 文言-華夏 (lzh) 以獲得增強體驗** **使用 文言-華夏 以獲更嘉之體驗** 新增傳說武器：**Vatansever** ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_e3ba962d-bed2-4fd7-938a-e495d09fffa4.png) 按下 **Shift** 鍵即可查看連招資訊。 ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_f9ad8556-db3e-4ffa-9110-a3202d20a413.png) 若您已安裝 [Epic Fight: Skill Tree](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-fight-skill-tree)，劍舞模組將預設提供一個技能樹。 ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_d3ca7e7f-83d3-405c-a526-63faaebadad6.png) 為 Epic Fight 新增多項劍技，尤其專精於劍舞。 您可透過 [SwordSoaringLivingMotions](https://github.com/GaylordFockerCN/SwordSoaring-Reborn/blob/1.20.1-20.12/src/main/java/net/p1nero/ss/gameassets/SwordSoaringLivingMotions.java) 為自訂武器設定專屬的劍舞動畫。 ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_07590108-40f6-49c0-aa2a-8111c16428b9.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_c7a2bcaa-4fa0-4e6f-8479-3c5811bb54cd.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_5e18b0f7-906c-42dd-b70f-bd0d558f0b88.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_8b39c607-9412-4c1b-9f7b-d74448f6dada.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_391e16ac-10cb-4868-a522-ed48c21d4897.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_0882f4c8-ae44-40e7-8ece-bd8b92909fb8.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_359e33b2-3507-42a5-8009-6072acec40e7.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_74b53299-98c1-40b5-810a-8eb16ee36844.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1011068/description_0a8200f1-4d02-4a8c-964e-27db8d8e2f7b.png)
